---
title: "05.Mobility_by_diet"
author: "Diego Coleto"

output: html_document
---

Which mobile elements explain the higher proportion of mobile ARG contigs in vegans (`03.Multi_ARG_by_diet.Rmd`),
and whether the difference is explained by the bacterial hosts.

* MAP annotations are split into **mobile genetic elements** (plasmid, insertion sequence, integron, conjugative
  integron, prophage, viral sequence) and **structural evidence** (direct / inverted repeats, compositional outliers),
  which are signatures of past mobility rather than mobile elements themselves.
* Contig-level logistic mixed models, as in script 03:
  outcome ~ diet group + log(contig length) + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth + (1 | sample).
* Host adjustment: the same model adding the host genus (10 most frequent genera, rest pooled).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glmmTMB)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)

table_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r theme set, include=FALSE}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()))
```


# Data load

```{r data load}
arg_contigs <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_contigs.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_sample_summary <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_sample_summary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
contig_mge <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_mge.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

element_groups <- c(
  "plasmid"                 = "Mobile genetic element",
  "insertion_sequence"      = "Mobile genetic element",
  "integron"                = "Mobile genetic element",
  "conjugative_integron"    = "Mobile genetic element",
  "prophage"                = "Mobile genetic element",
  "viral_sequence"          = "Mobile genetic element",
  "direct_repeat_element"   = "Structural evidence",
  "inverted_repeat_element" = "Structural evidence",
  "compositional_outlier"   = "Structural evidence")

# One indicator column per element type
element_flags <- contig_mge %>%
  distinct(sample_id, contig_id, element_type) %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = element_type, values_from = present, values_fill = FALSE)

top_genera <- arg_contigs %>% filter(!is.na(genus)) %>% count(genus, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(genus)

contig_data <- arg_contigs %>%
  left_join(element_flags, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(names(element_groups)), ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)),
         mobile_strict = if_any(any_of(names(element_groups)[element_groups == "Mobile genetic element"])),
         structural_only = has_mobile_element & !mobile_strict,
         host = factor(case_when(genus %in% top_genera ~ genus,
                                 is.na(genus) ~ "Unassigned",
                                 TRUE ~ "Other genera"))) %>%
  inner_join(arg_sample_summary %>%
               transmute(sample_id,
                         diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
                         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
                         age, bmi, log10_depth, assembly_Mb, N50),
             by = "sample_id") %>%
  drop_na(bmi)

contig_data %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(),
            across(c(has_mobile_element, mobile_strict, structural_only, any_of(names(element_groups))),
                   ~ round(mean(.x) * 100, 1)))
```


# Element types by diet group

```{r element models}
covariates <- "log_contig_length + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth"

outcomes <- c(
  "has_mobile_element" = "Any MAP annotation",
  "mobile_strict"      = "Mobile genetic element",
  "structural_only"    = "Structural evidence only",
  setNames(str_to_sentence(str_replace_all(names(element_groups), "_", " ")), names(element_groups)))

# Only outcomes with enough positive contigs (rarer element types give separated, unstable models)
outcomes <- outcomes[map_lgl(names(outcomes), ~ sum(contig_data[[.x]]) >= 50)]

fit_diet <- function(outcome, extra = "") {
  glmmTMB(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ diet_group +", covariates, extra, "+ (1 | sample_id)")),
          data = contig_data, family = binomial)
}

tidy_diet <- function(fit) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "diet_group")) %>%
    transmute(contrast = paste(str_remove(term, "diet_group"), "vs Omnivore"),
              odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)
}

element_fits <- map(names(outcomes), fit_diet) %>% set_names(names(outcomes))

element_results <- imap_dfr(outcomes, ~ tidy_diet(element_fits[[.y]]) %>% mutate(outcome = .y, label = .x)) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(outcome %in% c("has_mobile_element", "mobile_strict", "structural_only") ~ "Summary",
                           TRUE ~ element_groups[outcome])) %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

element_results %>% select(label, contrast, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, p_adj) %>% print(n = Inf)

# Estimated probability for each diet group (other covariates at their mean), as in script 03
element_estimates <- imap_dfr(element_fits, function(fit, outcome_i) {
  emmeans(fit, ~ diet_group, type = "response") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(outcome = outcome_i, label = unname(outcomes[[outcome_i]]), diet_group,
              estimate = prob, conf_low = asymp.LCL, conf_high = asymp.UCL)
}) %>% as_tibble()

element_estimates %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x * 100, 1))) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

The BH family above mixes the three summary flags, which overlap with each other and with the element types.
For the manuscript the testing is therefore split:

* **Primary outcome**: `mobile_strict`, tested on its own with Tukey-adjusted pairwise odds ratios between the three
  groups, the adjustment used for every other diet contrast.
* **Individual element types**: Benjamini-Hochberg within each contrast, across the element types only.

The estimates are model-based probabilities at mean covariates with the participant effect at zero, so the crude
shares per diet group are exported next to them.

```{r primary mobility}
# revpairwise: odds ratios of the later group against the earlier one (Vegan / Omnivore), as in the other tables
strict_tukey <- emmeans(element_fits[["mobile_strict"]], revpairwise ~ diet_group, type = "response",
                        adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " / ") %>%
  transmute(outcome = "mobile_strict", label = "Mobile genetic element", group1, group2,
            odds_ratio = odds.ratio, conf_low = asymp.LCL, conf_high = asymp.UCL, p_adj = p.value,
            converged = isTRUE(element_fits[["mobile_strict"]]$sdr$pdHess)) %>%
  as_tibble()
strict_tukey

element_types_bh <- element_results %>%
  filter(group != "Summary") %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>%
  mutate(q_types_only = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(converged = map_lgl(outcome, ~ isTRUE(element_fits[[.x]]$sdr$pdHess))) %>%
  select(outcome, label, group, contrast, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, q_types_only, converged)
element_types_bh %>% print(n = Inf)

crude_shares <- contig_data %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
            mobile_strict = sum(mobile_strict), any_annotation = sum(has_mobile_element),
            plasmid = sum(plasmid), insertion_sequence = sum(insertion_sequence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  bind_rows(contig_data %>%
              summarise(contigs = n(), samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
                        mobile_strict = sum(mobile_strict), any_annotation = sum(has_mobile_element),
                        plasmid = sum(plasmid), insertion_sequence = sum(insertion_sequence)) %>%
              mutate(diet_group = "All")) %>%
  mutate(diet_group = as.character(diet_group),
         across(c(mobile_strict, any_annotation, plasmid, insertion_sequence), ~ .x / contigs,
                .names = "share_{.col}"))
crude_shares
```

```{r element plot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_elements <- element_results %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(unname(outcomes))),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Summary", "Mobile genetic element", "Structural evidence")),
         diet = str_remove(contrast, " vs Omnivore")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = odds_ratio, y = label, colour = diet, group = diet)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), width = 0.25, orientation = "y",
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6, orientation = "y")) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < 0.05), size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6, orientation = "y")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, name = "vs Omnivore") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16), labels = c("q ≥ 0.05", "q < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio among ARG contigs (log scale)", y = NULL)

plot_elements
```


# Host and assembly adjustment

```{r host adjustment}
host_outcomes <- c("has_mobile_element", "mobile_strict")

host_adjusted <- map_dfr(host_outcomes, function(outcome) {
  bind_rows(tidy_diet(fit_diet(outcome)) %>% mutate(model = "Main model"),
            tidy_diet(fit_diet(outcome, extra = "+ host")) %>% mutate(model = "+ host genus"),
            tidy_diet(fit_diet(outcome, extra = "+ log(assembly_Mb) + log(N50)")) %>%
              mutate(model = "+ assembly size and N50"),
            tidy_diet(fit_diet(outcome, extra = "+ host + log(assembly_Mb) + log(N50)")) %>%
              mutate(model = "+ host genus + assembly size and N50")) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcomes[outcome])
})

host_adjusted %>% filter(str_detect(contrast, "Vegan")) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

```{r host plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
host_mobility <- contig_data %>%
  group_by(host, diet_group) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), mobile = mean(has_mobile_element), mobile_strict = mean(mobile_strict), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(contigs >= 5)

host_order <- contig_data %>% count(host) %>% arrange(n) %>% pull(host)

plot_hosts <- host_mobility %>%
  mutate(host = factor(host, levels = host_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mobile, y = host, fill = diet_group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "% of ARG contigs with a MAP mobile annotation", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Host genera with ≥ 5 ARG contigs per diet group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

plot_hosts
```


# ARG genes on mobile contigs

```{r mobile genes}
mobile_genes <- contig_data %>%
  filter(mobile_strict) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(ARG_combination, delim = " + ") %>%
  count(diet_group, ARG_gene = ARG_combination, name = "copies") %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  mutate(percentage = copies / sum(copies)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(diet_group, desc(copies))

mobile_genes %>% group_by(diet_group) %>% slice_head(n = 8) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Mobility_element_types_by_diet.png"), plot_elements, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
